verdicts.reason: A shrinks the bottle, which is the hero product, to a tiny icon jammed beside the CTA. It puts SOLSTICE below the headline and leaves the lower half as dead space between the circles. B keeps the bottle at a usable size, but it moves 'Find a Store' to the top above the headline, which breaks the reading order. B also runs the body copy edge to edge with almost no margin and crowds the top while the bottom stays empty. B is slightly less bad because the product survives.
